instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a modest single-storey retail pavilion with a clear front sales area and a rear service band. The operator wants a small prep room carved out of the back-of-house area without changing the public retail zone or the outside envelope.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
